task_specification.objective: Make the shell, Warden animation, and representative dense-run profile closure-ready while preserving the authored cemetery, three weapon runtimes, encounter budgets, teardown and handoff mechanisms, and clean Godot boot.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by three distinct integration gaps: the shell relies on globally overlapping physical InputMap actions and a monolithic text/button presenter; the Warden adapter correctly rejects an intact actor source that supplies only one usable clip, so all seven semantic states remain unbound; and the dense-run fixture exposes bounded subsystem counters but does not yet prepare or report the complete final-wave/boss workload needed for native 1920x1080 qualification. The animation repair must therefore replace the incompatible intact actor binding with a compatible whole package and explicit profile, not repeat fallback-name or transform tuning.

stop_conditions: Do not expand work into deferred camera, primitive-scaffolding, or audio issues; patrol preserved behavior through validation only.

If no intact Warden package with seven compatible authored motions can be auditioned and bound, leave the animation issue open; do not reuse unrelated clips, synthesize whole-model motion, modify imported source files, or perform asset surgery.
Do not treat the prior 1280x720 llvmpipe measurement as a candidate performance defect or success. Native 1920x1080 profiling and the formal verdict remain host/Tester work.

Stop and repair or revert the responsible bounded change if the authored cemetery instance, three weapon runtimes, four-cue telegraph admission, ordinary-light budgets, neighbor registry, teardown receipts, terminal handoff, native project validation, or host boot regresses.
Do not claim issue or phase closure; only Tester and GameLoop Runtime may close issues and quality gaps.

strategy.rationale: Use three root-cause-specific treatments: centralize context ownership before input dispatch while rebuilding the two deficient shell presentations; replace the incompatible one-clip actor binding with one intact compatible animated actor and an explicit semantic profile; and extend the preserved density instrumentation into a complete, stable final-wave profiling fixture. This changes strategy after two unsuccessful animation treatments and separates candidate implementation from host-owned recapture.

code: Run the frozen native Godot project validation and host boot checks; require no fatal import, resource, GDScript, or recurring runtime errors.
Inspect project.godot and the input router statically to confirm physical controls are not independently dispatched by simultaneous gameplay and shell owners.
Inspect the Warden scene/profile binding to confirm one intact actor package, seven explicit distinct clip mappings, no loose unrelated fallbacks, and no edits to imported source assets.
Inspect editor-only fixture registration and export guards; validation actions must be unbound and absent or inert in release exports.
runtime: Tester replays keyboard and gamepad press/hold/release/interruption across gameplay, Pause, Settings, Draft, failure Result, victory Result, Retry, and Return to Title, pairing black-box transitions with router context/generation receipts.
Tester exercises all seven Warden states through authoritative gameplay events, checks resolved clips and transitions, then repeats death/victory and Retry to verify reset isolation.

GameLoop Runtime/Tester captures the representative 25–40-enemy final-wave and Bellkeeper workload at native 1920×1080, records p50/p95/p99/worst frame time and subsystem counters, and compares three complete Retry baselines for growth.

Patrol preserved automatic attack cadence/target legality, enemy telegraphs and cleanup, three weapon identities, pause ownership, four-cue admission, light budgets, neighbor registry, terminal teardown, and clean logs.
visual: Recapture paused Settings at 90%, 100%, and 125% UI scale plus failure and victory Results with keyboard and gamepad focus; reject clipping, repeated-row styling, generic repeated icons, text-only build identity, or central-arena obstruction.

Capture Warden idle, locomotion, dash onset/recovery, cast impact, hurt, death, victory, and post-Retry idle from the shipped high-angle view, adding only defect-focused close-ups needed to judge rig contact, orientation, or attachments.

Capture a native 1920×1080 representative dense final-wave/Bellkeeper frame and confirm the player, hostile telegraphs, pickups, weapon causality, HUD, and boss health remain readable at real density.

done_when: A white-box InputMap/router inspection shows one authoritative context owner for Space/gamepad south and Escape/gamepad back/start semantics; gameplay, Pause, Settings, Draft, Result, and Result-to-Title handoffs expose only the actions legal for their current context and generation.

Black-box press, hold, release, and interruption probes show exactly one dash or one focused UI activation per physical activation, with no dash behind a page, no confirm leaking into gameplay, no pause/cancel double transition, and no held-confirm selection or terminal handoff duplication.

Settings groups audio, display, feedback, accessibility, and targeting with restrained dividers and semantically distinct icon-plus-label treatments; it no longer presents eleven equivalent bordered rows or one repeated glyph, and every required value still persists and mutates independently.

Failure and victory Results render truthful equipped-weapon silhouettes/icons with ranks and compact values plus a visually separate selected-upgrade summary; Retry is the clear initial primary action, Return to Title remains available, and keyboard/gamepad focus is visible.
The shell remains full-viewport and unclipped at native viewport, fullscreen, windowed mode, and 90%, 100%, and 125% UI scales; color is not the sole indicator of focus or setting state.

Visible asset family plan: family_id=shell_semantic_iconography; prd_style_match=etched lantern-brass and moon-silver dark-fantasy icon language; source_quality_class=coherent product-authored or suitably licensed vector icon family; material_and_texture_evidence=runtime-imported native-transparent SVG/RGBA with clean edges at supported scales; expected_runtime_uses_or_visible_area_share=eleven17?
tasks.instructions: Repair the product shell as one bounded interaction/presentation family. Introduce an authoritative context router or equivalent pre-dispatch owner so shared physical controls resolve to gameplay or shell semantics according to active run/page state, with handled-event and generation receipts. Preserve the existing process ownership and generation-aware terminal handoff. Refactor the generated Settings and Result composition so settings use restrained semantic grouping and Result uses data-bound icon-plus-value build identity instead of text piles. Keep all persisted settings and existing title/pause/result routes functional. For shell_semantic_iconography use at least eight semantically distinct source/runtime variants across audio, display, effects, accessibility, targeting, Warden Lantern, Gravespade, and Wandering Wisps; maximum single-variant share 0.25; diversity axes are role silhouette, internal mark, and brass/moon-silver emphasis rather than tint-only copies; background_mode=native_transparent_rgba; runtime_evidence_views=paused Settings at 90/100/125% and failure/victory Results with keyboard and gamepad focus.
tasks.title: Give the shell authoritative input contexts and authored Settings/Result presentation

done_when: The runtime Warden binds idle, locomotion, dash, cast, hurt, death, and victory to seven distinct, semantically compatible authored clips through explicit profile entries; telemetry reports binding_valid=true, the resolved clip for every semantic, and no missing semantics.

Actual planar velocity selects idle/locomotion, dash phases select dash, and authoritative combat/health/result events select cast, hurt, death, and victory at their causal moments; attack impact timing remains aligned with gameplay and event holds cannot be overwritten prematurely by locomotion.

Representative gameplay captures show visible authored motion for all seven states with stable rig orientation, feet, lantern/weapon attachment, ground contact, and transition blends; no state is represented by whole-model spin, bounce, tint, or translation.

Death and victory cannot return to a living locomotion pose before their authoritative transition, and Retry resets the new actor/profile to idle without duplicate AnimationPlayers, stale holds, or inherited state.

tasks.instructions: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from the prior fallback treatments: audition and bind one compatible intact animated actor package, preserving its rig, meshes, materials, and AnimationLibrary as a whole, then map exact authored clip names through a product-owned semantic profile.
